notes: Verse 17: judge every one of these by the strength and weakness of the planets involved. 'Conjunct or aspected by A and B' is encoded as requiring the influence of every planet named.

skipped.reason: 5th and 9th lords and planets joining them give wealth in their dashas: a timing rule, to be added with the dasha rules.
Divisional dignities (Parijata, Uttama, Gopura ...) of angular and trinal lords: needs the varga-dignity count.

rules.text: Venus in its own sign in the 5th with Mars in the 11th: great riches.
Mercury in its own sign in the 5th with the Moon, Mars and Jupiter in the 11th: extreme wealth.
The Sun in Leo in the 5th with Saturn, the Moon and Jupiter in the 11th: extreme wealth.
Saturn in its own sign in the 5th with the Sun and Moon together in the 11th: extreme wealth.
Jupiter in its own sign in the 5th with Mercury in the 11th: extreme wealth.
Mars in its own sign in the 5th with Venus in the 11th: extreme wealth.
The Moon in Cancer in the 5th with Saturn in the 11th: fabulous wealth.
The Sun in Leo in the ascendant, joined or aspected by Mars and Jupiter: endowed with wealth.
The Moon in Cancer in the ascendant, joined or aspected by Mercury and Jupiter: wealthy.
Mars in its own sign in the ascendant, joined or aspected by Mercury, Venus and Saturn: very rich.
Mercury in its own sign in the ascendant, joined or aspected by Saturn and Jupiter: endowed with wealth.
Jupiter in its own sign in the ascendant, joined or aspected by Mercury and Mars: wealthy.
Venus in its own sign in the ascendant, joined or aspected by Saturn and Mercury: wealthy.
Saturn in its own sign in the ascendant, joined or aspected by Mars and Jupiter: endowed with wealth.

The angles are the houses of Vishnu and the trines the houses of Lakshmi; a link between an angular lord and a trinal lord (by exchange, mutual aspect, one-way aspect or conjunction, in descending order of strength) produces raja yoga — status together with prosperity.
